# DataTables Frontend

For large datasets:
- Use server-side processing.
- Debounce expensive searches where appropriate.
- Keep column definitions aligned with server response fields.
- Handle loading and AJAX errors.
- Preserve stable sorting and pagination.
- Avoid rendering unnecessary hidden data.
- Keep action buttons accessible and permission-aware.
- Use responsive/table scrolling intentionally on smaller screens.
